posts.title: Navy, stone, olive: three colours that always work
posts.idea: Farbregel Navy · Stein · Oliv als nachmachbare Herbstkombination

posts.caption:
Navy, stone, olive. Three quiet colours that never fight each other, so you can get dressed in the dark in November.

Navy knit on top, stone wool trousers, and the olive coat for when the wind picks up. Brown suede shoes tie it together.

Which of the three would you wear first?
